${id}:config.raysCast.description: # of Rays to cast from players\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
${id}:config.raysBounced.description: Max # of times the ray will bounce before terminating\n(More accurate for hearing sounds after bouncing off walls, INCREASING THIS WILL INCREASE REVERB)\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
${id}:config.maxRayLength.description: Max Length of a singular ray, if you don't get reverb, turn this value up. if you get too much reverb, turn this down\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: LOW
${id}:config.tickRate.description:
How often sounds' positions should be updated
(0 is off)
(1 = every tick -> 20 = every second)
PERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
${id}:config.soundMult.description: 1 is just default Minecraft sound dist\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
${id}:config.reverb.description: Cast Blue (Reverb Detecting) Rays and add reverb dynamically to sources\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
${id}:config.permeation.description: Cast Red (Permeating) Rays and add muffle dynamically to permeated sources\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
${id}:config.permeationStepSize.description: lower = more performance hurt\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
${id}:config.permeatedTickRate.description:
How often permeated sounds' positions should be updated
(0 is off)
(1 = every tick -> 20 = every second)
PERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM (higher than normal tickrate)
${id}:config.attenuationType.description: This setting is now largely irrelevant, if you liked the way the mod sounded in the past, this helps. otherwise ignore\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: NONE
${id}:config.rayBounce.description: Larger = less heavily the sound will be coming from walls (will make likely make sounds quieter)\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: NONE
${id}:config.debug.description: puts sound names in chat. \nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: SMALL
${id}:config.maxBlocksPermeated.description: Max blocks permeated in the calculation
${id}:config.permeationAbsorption.description: Volume is multiplied by x^blocksTraveled where x is the value set here for muffle
${id}:config.barrierAsAir.description: Make it so barriers do NOT absorb sound
${id}:config.reverbTuning.description: Debug for finding what values are coming out of Blue ray casting.
${id}:config.legacyReverb.description: Switches reverb mode to different versions TUNING IS NOT ALWAYS AVAILABLE
${id}:config.globalReverbIntensity.description: Overall reverb intensity multiplier\nHigher = more intense reverb
${id}:config.indoorBias.description: Emphasis for indoor reverb characteristics\nHigher = more pronounced indoor reverb
${id}:config.outdoorBias.description: Emphasis for outdoor reverb characteristics\nHigher = more pronounced outdoor reverb
${id}:config.smallRoomEmphasis.description: Emphasis for small room characteristics\nHigher = more intimate small room feel
${id}:config.largeRoomEmphasis.description: Emphasis for large room characteristics\nHigher = more spacious large room feel
${id}:config.distanceAttenuationLinear.description: Linear distance attenuation factor\nHigher = sound drops off faster with distance
${id}:config.distanceAttenuationQuadratic.description: Quadratic distance attenuation factor\nHigher = more realistic distance falloff
${id}:config.airAbsorptionRate.description: How quickly air absorbs sound\nHigher = more muffled distant sounds
${id}:config.roomVolumeMultiplier.description: Room volume estimation factor\nHigher = treats rooms as larger
${id}:config.roomComplexityDivisor.description: Surface/volume complexity factor\nLower = treats rooms as more complex
${id}:config.lateReverbDelayMultiplier.description: Late reverb delay vs early reflections\nHigher = later late reverb
${id}:config.baseReverbGain.description: Minimum reverb gain\nHigher = always some reverb present
${id}:config.reverbGainMultiplier.description: How much reverb strength affects final gain\nHigher = more responsive to reverb conditions
${id}:config.maxOverallGain.description: Maximum overall reverb gain\nPrevents reverb from being too loud
${id}:config.sendFilterHfReduction.description: High frequency reduction for send filter\nLower = more muffled reverb
${id}:config.minDiffusion.description: Minimum reverb diffusion\nLower = more directional reflections
${id}:config.maxDiffusion.description: Maximum reverb diffusion\nHigher = more scattered reflections
${id}:config.minDensity.description: Minimum reverb density\nLower = more sparse reflections
${id}:config.decayLfMultiplier.description: Low frequency decay ratio multiplier\nHigher = longer low frequency decay
${id}:config.outdoorHfLeak.description: High frequency leak for outdoor spaces\nHigher = less muffled outdoor sound
${id}:config.echoTimeMultiplier.description: Echo time based on room size\nHigher = longer echo times
${id}:config.echoDepthMultiplier.description: Echo depth based on density\nHigher = more pronounced echoes
${id}:config.modulationTimeMultiplier.description: Modulation time based on room size\nHigher = slower modulation
${id}:config.modulationDepthMultiplier.description: Modulation depth based on enclosure\nHigher = more modulation
${id}:config.baseHfReference.description: Base high frequency reference (Hz)\nHigher = affects higher frequencies
${id}:config.hfRoomSizeFactor.description: How room size affects HF reference\nHigher = more room size influence
${id}:config.baseLfReference.description: Base low frequency reference (Hz)\nHigher = affects higher low frequencies
${id}:config.lfRoomSizeFactor.description: How room size affects LF reference\nHigher = more room size influence
${id}:config.roomRolloffSizeFactor.description: How room size affects rolloff\nHigher = less room size influence on rolloff
${id}:config.rt60SabineConstant.description: Sabine's RT60 formula constant\nPhysics constant - usually don't change
${id}:config.minTotalAbsorption.description: Minimum absorption to prevent division by zero
${id}:config.diffusionComplexityWeight.description: Weight of room complexity in diffusion calculation\nHigher = complexity affects diffusion more
${id}:config.diffusionEnclosureWeight.description: Weight of enclosure in diffusion calculation\nHigher = enclosure affects diffusion more
${id}:config.diffusionReverbWeight.description: Weight of reverb strength in diffusion calculation\nHigher = reverb strength affects diffusion more
${id}:config.soundBlacklist.description: Does not have to be a full match, will blacklist anything that CONTAINS that name
${id}:config.soundTickBlacklist.description: Does not have to be a full match, will blacklist anything that CONTAINS that name
